simple.summary: גּוּמָּץ (gûwmmâts) means a pit First listed occurrence: Eccl 10 8.

definitions.full: H1475. gummats גּוּמָּץ noun masculine pit (Aramaic loan-word, compare גּוּמְצָא , ; Late Hebrew גּוּמָּצָא compare Ba NB 66, Anm.I ), Eccl 10:8 ׳ג יִמּ֑וֺל בּוֺ חֹפֵר he that diggeth a pit shall fall in to it ; so also Prov 26:27 ᵑ6 ᵑ7 where HCT שַׁחַת כֹּרֶה .
